entities.title: Mim8 Bispecific Antibody Prophylaxis in Hemophilia A with or without Inhibitors
entities.summary: A twice-monthly injectable antibody protected people with hemophilia A, including those whose disease no longer responds to standard clotting factor treatment, from spontaneous bleeding.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Department of Biomedical Sciences, Humanitas University

entities.title: Cagrilintide-semaglutide (CagriSema) as an add-on to basal insulin in adults with type 2 diabetes (REIMAGINE 3): a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre, phase 3 study
entities.summary: Adding a combined GLP-1/amylin drug to insulin markedly improved blood sugar control and weight in people with hard-to-manage type 2 diabetes, pointing to a new class of add-on obesity-diabetes therapy.

institution.name: Division of Endocrinology, University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center

entities.title: A Pragmatic Trial of a 6-Month Strategy for Rifampicin-Resistant Tuberculosis
entities.summary: A South African-led trial showed a simpler 6-month all-oral regimen cures drug-resistant tuberculosis as well as longer treatments, making a debilitating disease easier to treat in resource-limited settings.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Isango Lethemba TB Research Unit, University of the Witwatersrand

entities.title: Re-administration of AAV-mediated gene therapy for OTOF-related deafness: a single-arm trial
entities.summary: Chinese researchers safely re-dosed a gene therapy in children born deaf from an OTOF mutation, showing repeat treatment can extend hearing restoration as the effect from a first dose fades.

institution.name: ENT Institute, Eye & ENT Hospital, Fudan University

entities.title: Multidomain lifestyle intervention for the prevention of cognitive decline in at-risk older adults in Latin America (LatAm-FINGERS): a single-blind, multicentre, randomised controlled trial
entities.summary: A large, first-of-its-kind Latin American trial found that a combined diet, exercise, and brain-training program measurably slowed cognitive decline in older adults at risk of dementia.

entities.title: Oral step-down, optimal drug, and total duration of antibiotic treatment in African children hospitalised with severe community-acquired pneumonia (PediCAP): a factorial randomised controlled trial
entities.summary: A multi-country African trial found children hospitalized with severe pneumonia can safely switch to oral antibiotics sooner and finish shorter courses, easing treatment burden across the region.

institution.name: Centre for Neonatal and Paediatric Infection, City St George's, University of London

entities.title: A bispecific CD3×CD19 antibody for systemic lupus erythematosus: a phase 1 trial
entities.summary: A Chinese-developed antibody that temporarily links T cells to B cells produced deep remission in lupus patients without the cell-collection process CAR-T therapy requires, hinting at an off-the-shelf alternative.

institution.name: Department of Rheumatology and Immunology, Union Hospital, Huazhong University of Science and Technology

entities.title: Large-scale esophageal cancer screening through noncontrast computed tomography and artificial intelligence
entities.summary: An AI system reading routine CT scans detected early esophageal cancer at large scale in China, potentially enabling screening in a country where the disease is common but rarely caught early.

entities.title: Phase 1 Study of Anito-cel, a d-Domain BCMA CAR T Cell for Refractory or Recurrent Myeloma
entities.summary: An early-phase trial of a redesigned CAR-T cell for multiple myeloma showed strong response rates while reducing the nerve-related side effects that limited earlier BCMA-targeted therapies.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: Cellular Immunotherapy Program, Mass General Brigham Cancer Institute

entities.title: Etuvetidigene Autotemcel for the Treatment of Wiskott-Aldrich Syndrome
entities.summary: Gene-corrected stem cell therapy gave children with the rare, life-threatening immune disorder Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome durable immune and platelet function, offering an alternative to donor bone marrow transplant.
entities.journal: The New England journal of medicine

institution.name: San Raffaele Telethon Institute for Gene Therapy (SR-Tiget)
